The twelve Units of Klasse 10 (G+M) across the school
year. Each Unit covers roughly three teaching weeks.

| Unit | Title | Skills focus | Exam type |
|------|-------|--------------|-----------|
| 1 | [Transition After Grade 10](units/unit01_transition-after-grade-10.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 2 | [The World of Work](units/unit02_the-world-of-work.qmd) | reading, speaking, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 3 | [Digital Lives at Work](units/unit03_digital-lives-at-work.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 4 | [Australia Now](units/unit04_australia-now.qmd) | reading, listening, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 5 | [Media and Truth](units/unit05_media-and-truth.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 6 | [Contemporary Short Fiction](units/unit06_contemporary-short-fiction.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 7 | [Mediation: A Workplace Text](units/unit07_mediation-workplace-text.qmd) | mediation, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 8 | [Civic English: Rights and Voices](units/unit08_civic-english.qmd) | reading, speaking, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 9 | [Youth and the Future](units/unit09_youth-and-the-future.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 10 | [Project and Presentation](units/unit10_project-and-presentation.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 11 | [A Short Novel](units/unit11_a-short-novel.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 12 | [Year Review: Graduation Exam Prep](units/unit12_year-review-graduation.qmd) | writing, speaking, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
